Using FloatSheets.

What the live beta does, what you authorize, and the limits to keep in mind.

Updated 24 September 2026 · Live beta

{01}

The service.

FloatSheets provides an interface and supporting services for USDG-settled synthetic equity positions and vault liquidity on Robinhood Chain. The beta uses real wallets, real tokens, and deployed contracts. Synthetic positions are not shares in the referenced companies. Read the risk disclosure before trading or providing liquidity.

{02}

Your wallet and transactions.

You control your wallet and approve its requests. The service prepares transaction data; your wallet signs and submits transactions. Check the network, recipient, amount, allowance, price, fee, and action before signing. Never share your recovery phrase or private key. Connecting a wallet is not the same as approving a token transfer.

{03}

Opening and closing positions.

Trading can require separate approval, margin-deposit, and execution transactions. A successful deposit is not a successful trade. Cancelling or failing a later transaction does not undo earlier confirmed steps. Unused margin may be withdrawn subject to contract checks. Quotes expire, and a displayed price is not a guarantee that a transaction will succeed at that price.

{04}

Fees and settlement.

Quotes currently apply a trading fee of 0.06% of the traded notional, subject to contract limits and rounding. Review the actual fee in each quote: rates and market settings can change. Spreads, liquidation penalties, and ETH network fees are separate costs. Users pay gas for their wallet transactions, including vault withdrawals. This version does not apply periodic funding-rate payments between longs and shorts.

{05}

Providing liquidity.

Depositing USDG into the shared vault gives you vault shares, not a fixed-interest account. Their redemption value changes with vault assets, including settled trader profits and losses. Trading fees are directed to the configured fee recipient; they are not automatically a promised LP fee reward. Withdrawals require sufficient available liquidity. Returns and immediate access to deposited funds are not guaranteed.

{06}

Availability and responsible use.

The interface, quote service, price publisher, or network may be unavailable. Risk controls and administrative changes can restrict actions. You are responsible for checking whether your use is permitted where you live and for any applicable reporting or tax obligations. Do not use the service for unlawful activity or interfere with its operation. Beta access is not a promise of uninterrupted service or future features.

{07}

Questions and current information.

Review the protocol overview and privacy information for how the system and its data flows work. The deployed contracts govern whether an on-chain action succeeds; explanatory text does not override their checks. Security concerns can be sent to security@floatsheets.app.
